note: Honest coverage frontier. status: present = a runnable step drives real code and passes (must name a test); pending = specified behavior whose implementation does not exist yet; retrospective_gap = shipped without a driving test (must be zero for governed behavior, INV-22). The implementation (core/groundnet envelope + adapter seam + the core/trace generalizable projection) is BUILT but DORMANT, so every scenario now binds to real code and executes strictly — none is pending. The contract itself stays Draft (not Ratified) pending the docs/FEDERATION-VISION.md § 7 blockers (the flywheel graduating an artifact, the loadable-not-hardcoded prose migration, and the decision-tracer archive).

scenarios.name: The wisdom-chunk envelope is a versioned signed unit with the stable field set
scenarios.test: spec/021 acceptance registerStatementLayerSteps — a real signed SCITT statement parses + ValidateEnvelope succeeds independently of the payload, with iss/sub/kid/content_type + a Receipt present (core/groundnet Sign/ParseStatement/ValidateEnvelope)

scenarios.name: The two-layer marker keeps every chunk generalizable and the estate-specific layer has no export path
scenarios.test: spec/021 acceptance registerGovernanceSteps — a session trace populated in every estate slot (host/ticket/action id/plan hash/rule/reason/credential ref) projects via trace.ProjectGeneralizable + NewChunk to a payload containing none of it and no free-text diagnosis; the estate layer has no export path because the Emit input type has no estate slot

scenarios.name: The payload is versioned and evolvable while the envelope stays stable
scenarios.test: spec/021 acceptance registerStatementLayerSteps — a statement with an unknown content_type: ValidateEnvelope still succeeds while DecodeWisdom rejects the unknown media type (envelope stable across payload versions)

scenarios.name: The producer attestation is a stable pseudonym and reputation accrues to it not an identity
scenarios.test: spec/021 acceptance registerStatementLayerSteps — the Issuer is a gnpub pseudonym (no x5t/x5chain, refused by ValidateEnvelope) and reputation accrues to the pseudonym via the core/groundnet Reputation rollup

scenarios.name: A chunk whose signature does not verify is refused before ingest
scenarios.test: spec/021 acceptance registerStatementLayerSteps — the valid statement verifies (core/groundnet Verify) while a tampered one is refused before ingest

scenarios.name: Provenance is anchored in a signed append-only transparency log and not a blockchain
scenarios.test: spec/021 acceptance registerMechanismSteps — a real Emit registers the statement in the local Translog for a Receipt; the Receipt verifies (VerifyLocal), a tampered chain fold fails verification (tamper-evidence), and it carries the append-only inclusion-proof fields (domain/entry/head/anchor), not a blockchain block

scenarios.name: The groundnet log extends the local hash-chained governance ledger
scenarios.test: spec/021 acceptance registerMechanismSteps — two anchored statements each carry an audit anchor digest over the chain HEAD (the governance-ledger model) and the append-only HEAD position advances, both verifying against the producing node's local Translog

scenarios.name: Reputation aggregates signed verified-outcome attestations weighted by quality not volume
scenarios.test: spec/021 acceptance registerGovernanceSteps — the reputation rollup weights clean positive and deviation negative (clean outscores deviation); a duplicate re-confirm and a producer self-confirm do not inflate (one distinct clean confirmation weighs exactly 1.0); a second distinct confirmer aggregates commutatively to 2.0 — quality, not volume

scenarios.name: The adapter seam emits from the generalizable layer and ingests into local re-graduation
scenarios.test: spec/021 acceptance registerMechanismSteps — node A Emit (a Chunk from trace.GeneralizableLayer) → node B Ingest lands it as a candidate in node B's ReGrad; a projection of a session carrying estate data (host/ticket/action id) yields a chunk payload containing none of it (de-identification by type)

scenarios.name: An ingested chunk is a subordinate hint that passes the full local gate stack
scenarios.test: spec/021 acceptance registerMechanismSteps — an ingested foreign chunk lands as a subordinate candidate and its local ReGrad.Level is the propose-only never-auto floor (LevelApprove), so it cannot bypass the floor toward auto

scenarios.name: An ingested chunk re-graduates locally before it earns any local standing
scenarios.test: spec/021 acceptance registerMechanismSteps — a chunk that graduated to LevelAuto on its producing node reads LevelApprove on the consumer right after ingest (no inherited trust) and only reaches LevelAuto after the consumer's OWN local graduation promotes it in its store

scenarios.name: Membership export and consumption are opt-in default-off and authenticated
scenarios.test: spec/021 acceptance registerGovernanceSteps — DefaultPosture federates nothing; a non-admin (empty principal) is refused with ErrNotOrgAdmin; a deliberate org-admin opt-in enables member/export/consume/public and records the authenticated principal

scenarios.name: Consumption is never gated behind contribution and no over-share is required
scenarios.test: spec/021 acceptance registerGovernanceSteps — a member with Consume on but Export off consumes freely though it contributes nothing; MayConsume depends only on membership+consume, never on export or a contribution ratio

scenarios.name: A node is born groundnet-compatible while the local tracer does not depend on the contract
scenarios.test: spec/021 acceptance registerGovernanceSteps — the local tracer projects standalone (no groundnet), the export adapter consumes the tracer's output type (groundnet->trace), the seam is dormant by default, and go list -deps asserts core/trace does NOT depend on core/groundnet

scenarios.name: A shared chunk is treated as unrecallable and the export decision is the last point of control
scenarios.test: spec/021 acceptance registerGovernanceSteps — emit is gated (default-off) until the org-admin export decision (the last point of control), and the emitted chunk is stamped an unrecallable GovernedRecord declaring retention + provenance

scenarios.name: A replayed or duplicate chunk is rejected by its id and provenance anchor
scenarios.test: spec/021 acceptance registerMechanismSteps — the same statement bytes (same sub + Receipt) ingested twice: the first lands as a candidate, the second is refused as DispositionRejectedReplay keyed on the same content-address subject, so one statement earns standing at most once per node
